description: Public Storage, as the largest owner of self-storage facilities, believes it owns approximately 9 percent of the self-storage square footage in the U.S. and that collectively the four largest self-storage owners in the U.S. own approximately 22 percent, with the remaining 78 percent owned by regional and local operators, and it believes its Public Storage brand awareness, as well as the innovative improvements it has made to the customer experience, provide it with a competitive advantage in acquiring and retaining customers relative to other self-storage operators, in a highly fragmented market for the ownership and operation of self-storage facilities.
